name: Vanaheim: the Rotwood Hollow
about: Vanaheim's main dungeon (story/verdant_heart.md section 4): eight root caverns under the Old Bough running down to the Regent's Bower. Glowing stream, hanging vines, violet blight fog, glow frogs and red toadstools. Art: the Verdant Heart pack (art/verdant_heart/), blight_bloom + violet mist for the rot.

exits.label: the root-cave up to Mossbrook Springs

sapling.label: the sapling's root-stair down to the Verdant Heart

art._note: Verdant Heart pack (art/verdant_heart/): rottreant / sporeelemental + boss sheets ride in their own sheets, verdant_fx + critters are appended to the gamefx atlas by build.py install_verdant_heart.

actors.name: Tobble Capwhistle, gnome scout
say: Pocket lantern's lit. Stay close, big-folk, and don't step in anything purple.
